chunks.title: Profile
chunks.heading: Who is Ali Zain
chunks.text: Ali Zain is a final-year undergraduate student and a web developer, UI designer and 3D artist from Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. He is studying for a B.S. in Gaming and Animation at NED University of Engineering & Technology (NEDUET) in Karachi. His portfolio tagline is "I build digital experiences that reach new heights." He turns ideas into clean, fast and beautiful websites, and he bridges artistic storytelling with real-time engineering: 3D characters, game engines, motion graphics and AI-powered web platforms.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.heading: Location and availability
chunks.text: Ali is based in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. He is open to freelance and full-time work, available in Karachi or remotely worldwide. He is open to Game Art, 3D Animation, Interactive Web, web development and UI/UX design roles, and he is aiming to work with international clients.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.heading: His story
chunks.text: It started with a laptop, a slow connection and a lot of curiosity in a small room in Karachi. He wanted to know how the websites he loved were put together, so he opened the code and kept going. Every broken layout taught him something, and every finished page made him want to build a bigger one. He cares about details most visitors never notice: clean structure, fast loading, smooth motion and calm, easy-to-use design.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.heading: Working principles
chunks.text: Clean Code: readable, structured code that is easy to grow. Pixel Perfect: designs built exactly as drawn. Fast Performance: light pages that load quickly. SEO Friendly: semantic markup that search engines can read.

chunks.title: Education
chunks.heading: Education
chunks.text: Degree: B.S. in Gaming and Animation. University: NED University of Engineering & Technology (NEDUET), Karachi, Pakistan. Years: 2022 to 2026. Ali is a final-year undergraduate. Specialisation: 3D character and environment modeling, rigging, real-time game engines (Unreal Engine 5 and Unity), motion graphics, and interactive AI systems.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.heading: Capstone Lead — 3D & Technical Art (2025 to now)
chunks.text: At the NED Game Dev & Digital Media Lab, Ali leads 3D asset optimisation (GLB PBR pipelines), character rigging and WebGL showcase engineering for the final-year exhibition in Karachi.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.heading: Freelance 3D & Motion Designer (2024 to 2025)
chunks.text: Remote and with Karachi creative studios: Ali produced Blender 3D visualisations, promotional After Effects motion reels and interactive product landing pages for indie game teams.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.heading: Freelance web work
chunks.text: In 2024 Ali delivered his first paid freelance website. He learned to listen to a client, plan the work, meet a deadline and ship something people actually use.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.heading: Journey timeline
chunks.text: 2023 — Started learning: wrote his first HTML and CSS; evenings became tutorials, experiments and small personal pages. 2024 — First freelance project. 2025 — Built 25+ projects: landing pages, dashboards, portfolios and interactive 3D pages with React, Next.js and Three.js. 2026 — Aiming for international clients; took part in the CodeSphere 3.0 Build4Better hackathon at NED University. Portfolio stats: 2+ years of experience, 25+ projects, 15+ happy clients.

chunks.title: Skills
chunks.heading: Web development skills
chunks.text: HTML/CSS 95% — semantic, accessible markup and modern responsive layouts. JavaScript 90% — interactive UI, animation and modern ES code. React 88% — reusable components, hooks and fast single-page apps. Next.js 85% — SEO-ready, server-rendered sites and full apps. UI/UX Design 92% — wireframes to polished interfaces in Figma. Tailwind CSS 93% — consistent design systems, built quickly. Also: Node.js, Three.js / WebGL, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) and vector search for AI chatbots.

chunks.title: Skills
chunks.heading: 3D, animation and game skills
chunks.text: 3D & animation: Blender 3D, Autodesk Maya, ZBrush sculpting, Substance 3D Painter, character modeling, IK/FK rigging, facial blendshapes, PBR texturing, GLTF/GLB web exports. Motion: Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro — kinetic typography, 3D camera tracking, compositing, showreels. Game engines: Unreal Engine 5 (including Niagara VFX) and Unity with C# (including Unity XR for VR).

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: Karachi Cyberpunk: Neon Rickshaw (Game Development)
chunks.text: A stylized 3D action-runner set in a futuristic Saddar and Clifton, Karachi, with custom Niagara VFX. How it was built: modular Karachi street props modeled in Blender, 4K PBR textures baked in Substance Painter, vehicle physics and neon lighting scripted in Unreal Engine 5. Tools: Unreal Engine 5, Blender, Substance Painter.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: Rigged Stylized 3D Avatar (3D Character)
chunks.text: A game-ready character with a full-body armature, facial blendshapes and real-time WebGL shaders. How it was built: sculpted a high-poly mesh, retopologized to clean quad topology (about 18k triangles) and exported rigged GLB animations for Three.js and Unity. Tools: Blender, IK/FK rig, GLB / glTF 2.0.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: 60s Kinetic VFX Showreel (Motion Design)
chunks.text: A promotional reel combining 3D camera tracking, kinetic typography and sound design. How it was built: Blender multi-pass EXR renders composited in After Effects with speed-ramped graph-editor curves and licensed audio. Tools: After Effects, Premiere Pro, 3D render passes.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: Interactive 3D Portfolio (Web Experience)
chunks.text: A scroll-choreographed 3D portfolio with a physics tech-stack and a grounded AI assistant. How it was built: Three.js real-time lighting, TF-IDF cosine-similarity retrieval with source citations, and an email contact flow. Tools: Three.js, Node.js, RAG.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: Mohatta Palace VR Tour (VR Experience)
chunks.text: A VR cultural-heritage walkthrough of Karachi's Mohatta Palace that won 1st Runner-Up at the Karachi Tech & Digital Arts Fest Game & VR Showcase (2024). How it was built: recreated the domes and courtyard lighting in Blender and Unity XR with spatial audio; textures in Substance Painter. Tools: Unity XR, Blender, C#.

chunks.title: Projects
chunks.heading: AI NPC Lore & Dialogue Engine (AI Engineering)
chunks.text: A context-aware NPC dialogue system grounded in verified world-lore documents. How it was built: retrieves relevant quest-lore chunks by vector similarity (embeddings + RAG) so NPCs answer from the game's real lore instead of making things up. Tools: embeddings, RAG, Unity C#.

chunks.title: This portfolio
chunks.heading: The 3D avatar
chunks.text: The portfolio includes "Meet the 3D Me": a real-time 3D version of Ali's mascot (brown checkered suit, white shirt, silver leaf pin, brown hair, big brown eyes, one hand in his pocket). It is modeled and textured, rigged with an 18-bone skeleton, has 4 expression morph targets (blink left, blink right, smile, surprised) and 5 animations (idle, wave, nod, surprised, celebrate), and is exported as a GLB (glTF 2.0) file. Visitors can rotate it, and its head follows the cursor. A Blender script rebuilds the same character in Blender.

chunks.title: This portfolio
chunks.heading: The showreel video
chunks.text: A 46-second promotional video (1920×1080, 30 fps) introduces Ali: his name and introduction, skills, six projects, the 3D avatar, achievements, and his contact email, with an original soundtrack and captions. An After Effects script rebuilds the video as an editable After Effects project.

chunks.title: This portfolio
chunks.heading: Site features
chunks.text: Dark and light themes, interactive 3D objects that respond to the mouse, project filtering, search, sorting and drag-to-reorder, privacy-friendly analytics, accessibility settings (text size, reduce motion, high contrast, underline links), this AI chatbot, and a contact form.
